_note: UI strings for the blog, per language. Article body copy lives in the article files themselves; this is only the furniture around it.
_topicsNote: The `topic` front-matter field is a CLOSED vocabulary of language-independent slugs; `topics` below is only its display label per language. Slugs are data, labels are presentation — an article keeps the same topic in all three languages, which is what lets the pill filter and the language switcher agree. Adding a topic means adding it here in all three languages AND to the closed list in writer_agent.py, or the writer will emit something the filter can't render. Added Aug 24, 2026, replacing `category` as the filter key: `category` is free text and the writer had invented 35 distinct values across 60 articles, so it could never drive pills. `category` survives as the fine-grained label on the article page itself.
_weightLossNote: `weight-loss` is in this list on commercial grounds, not editorial tidiness: it is a sport-agnostic theme sitting alongside sports, which is untidy, but weight-loss plans are around half of recent plan sales and three articles already target them. Filing those under running and cycling would bury the best-selling category on the site.
